SADV-03.note: 0.88^3 = 0.6815. Same mechanism as SADV-20 (repeated percent decay) and SADV-13 (exponential factor)

SADV-05.note: B (-8) is not a natural slip. Same mechanism family as SADV-18 (match a common base)

SADV-06.note: b=1; p(-1)=30. B (-4) is p(1), a good trap

SADV-08.note: x=1 or -3; -3 gives 1 = -1, extraneous, offered as B. Standard. Same mechanism family as SADV-17

SADV-10.note: x=-3, 2; sum -1. Vieta on x^2+x-6 gives the same directly, so the 'common factor' insight is optional

SADV-12.note: (m+2)^2=64, m=6 or -10; positive constraint disambiguates. C (10) is |-10|

SADV-13.note: 3^(2/5)=1.5518 -> 55.2. Needs a calculator; fine on Digital SAT

SADV-14.note: u=4 or -1; x^2=9 or 4; positive solutions 3+2=5. B (3) is the habit-reject-negative-u trap

SADV-17.note: 14 sqrt(x-4)=42 -> x=13; checks 4+3=7. No extraneous root arises
